evidence.quote: Our opening proposal is a $45 million class fund, with payments distributed automatically to all identified class members. We propose $9 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses
Avoid clear sailing and direct any fee reduction to the class
requests a fee that compensates counsel for the substantial contingency investment

summary: Class counsel raised fees in its opening proposal, alongside class relief, and privately considered compensation for its contingency investment. The proposed terms linked any court-ordered fee reduction to an increase in the class fund. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its fee, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading court declaration.
